prs.title: fix: sheet enter offscreen travel
prs.author: georgereade
prs.body:
Closes https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/issues/10808

## Summary

[Sheet](https://react-aria.adobe.com/Sheet) is visibly delayed when entering with `position="end" / "start"` on wide screens, as `onEnter` scrolls the container a full viewport. Sheets narrower or shorter than the viewport spend most of the animation off screen. Most noticeable on widescreens but reduces dead time in almost all cases (including mobile screens with `position="bottom"`).

## Fix

Jump to where the sheet's leading edge meets the viewport before smooth scrolling, so the animation is instant after clicking the trigger.

prs.title: fix(useHover): prevent stuck hover state in useHover after touch interactions
prs.author: reidbarber
prs.body:
Closes https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/issues/10823

On hybrid touch+mouse devices, elements can get stuck in an `isHovered` state after a touch interaction.

This is because in useHover, `triggerHoverEnd` cleared `state.target` before its early return for touch events. When a touch happened while an element was mouse-hovered, that element was left with `isHovered = true` but no `target`, so nothing could end the hover until it unmounted.

This PR:
- Moves the `state.target` / `state.pointerType` updates in `triggerHoverStart` and `triggerHoverEnd` after their early returns, so ignored touch events no longer change hover state.
- Clears the previous timeout in `setGlobalIgnoreEmulatedMouseEvents`, so a second tap within 500ms gets the full window for ignoring emulated mouse events.
